xray_and_em.rule: use the deposited model; where more than one model exists take the lowest model id
xray_and_em.determinism: model id ordering is numeric, not file order
xray_and_em.report: model_id is recorded on every contact row

nmr.rule: an NMR ensemble is NOT silently reduced to its first model. Minimum distance is computed per model and the ensemble fields are populated.
nmr.note: The schema supports these fields whether or not any NMR structure is present in the universe.

order: on an occupancy tie the alphabetically first altloc
altloc_policy.consistency_rule: within one residue, atoms from mutually incompatible conformers are never mixed: once an altloc is chosen for a residue, only blank and that altloc are used
altloc_policy.verification: tested against real parser behaviour on entries that carry altlocs

atom_policy.rationale: the contact definition is heavy-atom to heavy-atom; hydrogens are model-dependent
atom_policy.metals_and_ions: a metal or ion atom enters a contact observation only when the ligand entity's role permits it; environment ions produce no pharmacological contact

completeness_rule: a missing atom or residue is never silently treated as present
